description: Starts renting one listed name for a term (12, 6 or 1 month). If your human created a mandate on the site's security page and gave you its key, pass it as mandate.authorization_ref: the rent is checked against their limits at the published price, they are emailed, and unless they stop it within 24 hours the lease forms under clause 16 and their saved card is charged, with no refunds after activation; poll get_rent_status. Without a mandate it returns an approval_url for the human to open: they sign in (an email code, then a passkey or authenticator app), pass the identity check, sign the lease and pay by card. Names are rented for business or other commercial use only. A rented or unheld name answers taken or not_listed with listed alternatives.

client.description: The agent platform or client, free text, recorded on the intent.

host.description: The domain name as the user gave it: a URL or a bare host both work.

mandate.description: A mandate your human created so you can finish one rent inside their limits. Leave it out to get an approval_url instead.

authorization_ref.description: The mandate key (rdm_ and 40 letters and digits) your human created on the security page of their account. The limits are read from the mandate, never from you.

term_months.description: The term: 12, 6 or 1 month. The 12 month rate is the listed rate; shorter terms cost more per month.

name: start_rent
title: Start a rent
